case.title: CTI-REALM detection objective cloud_001
case.description: Write a detection rule to identify the creation of restricted management Administrative Units where privileged administrators create organizational containers with management restriction properties enabled, then add user accounts as members to these protected containers. This technique creates persistent backdoors where member accounts become resistant to standard modification and remediation operations. Monitor for AU creation operations through directory management APIs, followed by member addition activities, and consider authentication patterns and client types that may indicate automated or scripted access.

Focus on correlating AU management operations with role assignment activities.

case.title: CTI-REALM detection objective cloud_007
case.description: Write a detection rule to identify managed identity token theft from virtual machines by monitoring for command execution operations on VMs that have administrative managed identities attached. Attackers with VM command execution permissions can leverage this capability to retrieve OAuth tokens for the VM's managed identity, providing elevated privileges beyond their original permissions. Detection should correlate VM command execution operations with subsequent privileged resource management activities that indicate stolen tokens are being used outside the VM context.

case.title: CTI-REALM detection objective cloud_008
case.description: Write a detection rule to detect managed identity hijacking through identity attachment by monitoring for operations that attach existing administrative managed identities to virtual machines, followed by command execution on those VMs. This privilege escalation technique allows piggybacking on pre-existing high-privilege identities without creating new role assignments. The attack sequence involves identifying an existing privileged identity, attaching it to attacker-controlled infrastructure, executing commands to harvest the identity token, then using that token for privileged operations. Correlate identity attachment with VM operations and subsequent unusual privileged activities.

case.title: CTI-REALM detection objective cloud_010
case.description: Write a detection rule to detect storage account compromise and backdoor establishment by monitoring for a multi-stage attack: storage account enumeration, access credential retrieval operations, authenticated blob access showing data retrieval, and creation of new service principals with persistent access to the compromised storage. This indicates data exfiltration followed by establishment of resilient backdoor access. Detection should correlate the temporal sequence of storage discovery, credential access, data operations using those credentials, identity creation, and role assignments, all originating from the same compromised account.

Detection must correlate vault operations showing secret access with subsequent storage operations, analyzing the temporal relationship and identity patterns to link credential theft to credential usage across multiple log sources.

Detection requires correlation across enumeration patterns, credential management, service principal authentication, and role assignment operations.
